data.body: ROOT-CAUSE of PS1/PS2 Verified-1: NOT a code fault or flake. gerrit-verify.yaml uses concurrency group gerrit-verify-${GERRIT_CHANGE_ID} with cancel-in-progress:true. All patchsets of a change share the GERRIT_CHANGE_ID, so pushing PS(n+1) cancels PS(n)'s still-running run. The slow macos leg (default suite ~23min: 15913 passed, then integration) is what's caught mid-run; ubuntu legs finish faster. Evidence: PS2 macos = '15913 passed' then '##[error]The operation was canceled' 32s into integration, zero FAILED lines; all 3 ubuntu Pythons passed full suite. Implication: do NOT rapid-fire patchsets; PS3 (latest) will complete undisturbed if no PS4 is pushed => Verified should pass. Awaiting PS3 LLM-Review + Verified.
